$comment: Frontier step 2-bis: expected effects already measured, one entry per main lead (load-bearing hypothesis). The source follows the reference rules (VP verdicts). needed_test_size is the block written by tools/sim.py --needed-n and rerun by tools/check.py ([EVID-SIZE]). Structure only; the rules ([EVID-*]) are in tools/check.py.

lead.description: A load-bearing hypothesis id of hypotheses.json (H1...).

source.description: {id, run, claim, says}: a reference read through VP; null only when no effect is reported.

sample.description: What was measured, on what sample (size, population).

not_reported.description: The reason when the source gives no effect size.
